name: Copy a file without changing the original
short_description: Copy a file without changing the original once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can copy a file without changing the original in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Copy a file without changing the original means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Copy a file without changing the original in a fresh real-life scenario.
